political-processes-waves.alt: A timeline running down the page with four dates. 1776 to 1830s: the United States and most of Latin America break away from European empires. 1945 to 1975: most colonies in Africa and Asia win independence. 1991: the Soviet Union breaks into 15 states. 1993 to 2011: more new states such as Eritrea, Timor-Leste and South Sudan.
